description_en: Queries Layer 7 CC rules by calling DescribeLayer7CCRules
name: DescribeLayer7CCRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The start index position, which specifies the result number from which to start returning results. 

If you do not specify this parameter, results are returned starting from the 0th result
parameters.help_zh:
开始索引位置，即从第几个结果开始返回。 

若不传入该参数，则从第0个结果开始返回
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return on each page. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示过少个结果。最大值10。
parameters.name: page_size

Act.description_en:
The action to take when the rule is triggered. Valid values:

close: block
captcha: CAPTCHA verification
Act.description_zh:
规则触发后的操作，取值：

close：封禁
captcha：人机识别

Count.description_en: The number of accesses, used together with Interval. When the same IP address continuously accesses the specified number of times within the interval specified by Interval, the rule is triggered
Count.description_zh: 访问次数，与Interval结合使用。当同一个IP在Interval指定的间隔时间内连续访问Count中指定的访问次数，则触发规则。

Interval.description_en: The interval, used together with Count. When the same IP address continuously accesses the specified number of times within the interval specified by Interval, the rule is triggered
Interval.description_zh: 间隔时间，与Count结合使用。当同一个IP在Interval指定的间隔时间内连续访问Count中指定的访问次数，则触发规则。

Mode.description_en:
The URI matching mode. Valid values:

match: exact match. The URI of the access request must be exactly the same as the specified Uri to be counted as an access.
prefix: prefix match. The URI of the access request contains the specified Uri to be counted as an access
Mode.description_zh:
URI匹配模式，取值：

match：完全匹配。访问请求的URI与指定的Uri完全相同，才计入访问次数。
prefix：前缀匹配。访问请求的URI包含指定的Uri，则计入访问次数

Name.description_en: The name of the custom CC rule

Ttl.description_en: The blocking duration if the action triggered by the rule is set to block
Ttl.description_zh: 若规则触发后动作指定为封禁，设置封禁时间
